authorship_scope.basis: For 258 text-like paths, GitHub author histories map to the two accounts the owner confirmed as his: Agnuxo (user ID 165324954) and Agnuxo1 (user ID 166046035). Some additional commits have author.login=null; 37 such commits across 23 paths carry raw Git author name Agnuxo1. The owner confirmed that account, and those paths use contribution wording with this limitation recorded. Per-file raw Git blob IDs and SHA-256 are in provenance-baseline.json.
authorship_scope.limit: Git history and owner confirmation establish the attribution basis used here, but do not prove originality in a legal sense. The root README has shared history including shristibajpai and receives project-lead/maintainer credit only. The associated paper has six authors and is preserved unchanged. Third-party funding data, a third-party portrait, generated components, lockfiles, and mixed or other-account paths remain excluded.

license_scope.new_spdx_headers_scope: 219 native-comment attribution paths; exact per-file baseline records are in provenance-baseline.json. Strict formats and SVGs are recorded by sidecar only. Existing root/nested MIT texts and GitHub/CFF metadata remain unchanged; excluded, generated, third-party, coauthored, or mixed-history material is not newly claimed.
license_scope.scope_note: LICENSE_SCOPE.md documents the attribution review boundary and does not amend or replace any existing license. The root README contains the user-provided MIT reuse notice; PaperClaw README files now carry the same notice against their existing nested MIT licenses.

preferred_citation.title: OpenCLAW-P2P v2: Resilient Multi-Layer Persistence, Live Reference Verification, and Production-Scale Evaluation of Decentralized AI Peer Review

citation_scope.paper_source: Official arXiv record: https://arxiv.org/abs/2604.19792; local TeX/PDF and six-author citation were preserved unchanged.

third_party_contributions.scope: Quick Start text in README.md; explicitly acknowledged there.
third-party portrait; rights not established by repository commit history

security_review.scope: Current public baseline text-like files; no historical or full binary sweep was performed for this attribution update.
security_review.finding: The existing scanner reports one URL-userinfo-pattern match in a reliability-test fixture; the source line contains the dummy value admin-test, not a credential. No credential value was emitted or changed. The repository was already public.
